collection.title: Mini Convertible 2012 to 2016 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a Mini Cooper/One Convertible 2012 to 2016 model which requires a 18" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 19" for the passengers side. This model uses the Bayonet arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
